requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure no account can have a negative balance and automatically withdraw funds from a related saving account if insufficient in the checking account.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance for audit purposes.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication and data encryption to protect sensitive information.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds while optimizing energy consumption for operational efficiency.
The ATM system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances and notify users of insufficient funds.
The ATM system shall support energy-efficient hardware and practices to minimize overall energy consumption.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts to reduce waste.
The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
